x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

INF = 99999999
min_diff = INF
numerator = 0
denominator = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    tx = int(round(1.0 * x * i / y - 0.0000001))
    current_diff = abs((1.0 * x / y) - (1.0 * tx / i))
    if current_diff < min_diff:
        numerator = tx
        denominator = i
        min_diff = current_diff

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
